concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-settle-funds-configure-closing-time]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms balance-account sales-day closing-time configuration guide for local hourly 00:00–07:00 cutoffs, conditional business-day settlement delay and method-schedule exceptions; response/webhook is settings evidence, not payout proof.
warnings: The sample says two business days but omits `settlementDelayDays`; its webhook example shows 06:00 after a 01:00 request/response example, so do not treat them as one verified operation.
Affirm and maestro_USA are documented as following method schedules instead of sales-day closing time.
